resources.description:
Originally published in April 2025. Last updated March 2026.

Since the last publication, the changes include: 
- Section C4.3 School Nutrition Grant is updated to distinguish between the Alberta School Nutrition Grant (C4.3.A) and the new National School Food Program (C4.3.B). 
- Section H7 Class Size and Complexity is added, providing targeted funding to support the establishment of Alberta Complexity Teams in public, separate, and francophone school authorities. 
- Page numbering is updated throughout as a result of the additional content.
resources.name: Funding manual for school authorities 2025/2026 school year

resources.description:
Originally published in March 2024.

Republished September 2024 with the following updates:

- The Distance Education Non-Primary Allocation (C1.5.C.1, D1.4.C.1) is updated with additional criteria to clarify the grant.
- The Guide to Education and Early Childhood Service Regulations are added as authoritative sources for this publication. 
- Updated funding rates for certain Base Instruction, Program Supports and Services, and Authority-Based grants. (I1.1, I1.2, I1.3).
- Miscellaneous minor corrections to dates and typos throughout the document.

Republished January 15, 2025 with the following updates:

- Section F has been updated to reflect the ratification of the Protocol for the Agreements for the Language Education and Second-Language Instruction 2024/25 to 2027/28.  
- The Learning Disruption Grant (H4) has been rebranded as Literacy and Numeracy Support Funding. Adjustments have been made to reflect the new name, requirements, and years included in this funding. 
- Section L has been updated to reflect new requirements for the Annual Education Results Report regarding H4 funding.
